scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive index checks and independent numerical solves supplement a complete all-length proof via a unique stable Lyapunov solution; no claim of independent audit or of exhaustive historical novelty.
scientific_limitations: Exact for all finite uniform paths of length at least two with equal positive end-site Lindblad losses, one excitation and positive coherent hopping; no unequal losses, bulk dephasing, other graph families, or complete first-passage distributions. Prior specialization may exist outside examined primary and indexed literature.
title: Exact two-boundary absorption-time kernel for coherent quantum paths
